name: KY-02
label: Safe R

key_factors: Deeply Republican district with a PVI of R+20
Incumbent Brett Guthrie has a massive financial advantage ($4.7M raised vs. $7.5K)
Prediction markets price Guthrie at roughly 96% to win
No public polling or expert ratings signal a competitive race
model.rationale: Kentucky's 2nd District is a strongly Republican seat, and Guthrie is a well-funded incumbent facing a challenger who has raised almost nothing. Markets and fundamentals both point to an easy Republican hold, with no evidence of a meaningful Democratic campaign.
model.watch: Any late surge in outside spending against Guthrie or a major scandal would be the only plausible path to making this competitive.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Kentucky's 2nd District is a solidly Republican seat, and Brett Guthrie is seeking another term as its well-established incumbent. He has raised about $4.7 million and holds over $1.7 million in cash, while Democratic nominee Megan Wingfield has raised under $8,000 and has essentially no resources for a general-election campaign. No outside groups are spending against Guthrie.

There is no public polling in the race and no expert ratings, but prediction markets give Guthrie roughly a 96% chance of winning. The district's strong Republican lean and the lopsided financial picture make an upset highly unlikely; the main question is the size of Guthrie's victory margin, not the outcome.
